The Event

About AI Vision 2027

AI Vision 2027 is a business-focused forum connecting leaders, technology experts, industry representatives and future partners from Vietnam and Singapore, with one clear goal: to turn AI from promise into practical business results.

Through expert talks, live AI solution showcases and curated networking, delegates will see how emerging technologies solve real business challenges, raise operational efficiency and open new doors for innovation and cross-border collaboration.

About Us

About VNPT-IT and VNPT Technology

VNPT-IT

VNPT Information Technology Company is a member of VNPT Group and one of Vietnam's leading providers of digital transformation solutions for government, enterprises and citizens, in Vietnam and international markets. Its products reach international markets through VNPT Global Solutions (VGS), the VNPT unit that takes VNPT products and solutions to global customers.

2,500+technology experts
150+digital products and solutions

  • Capabilities: Global delivery, system integration, cybersecurity, AI & data solutions and managed cloud services

  • Certified: ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001 and Uptime Tier III data centres

VNPT Technology

A leading Vietnamese electronics designer and manufacturer and a member of VNPT Group, VNPT Technology delivers network equipment, smart devices and AI-integrated hardware in Vietnam for telecommunications operators and international brands, offering an end-to-end process from concept to mass production.

Our Partners

In collaboration with

Vietnam Trade Office in Singapore

Vietnam’s official trade representative in Singapore, under the Ministry of Industry and Trade.

  • Connects Vietnamese and Singaporean businesses
  • Market information and guidance on Singapore
  • Supports Vietnamese firms on trade issues

Singapore A.I. Association (SAIA)

Helps businesses, especially SMEs, turn AI from ambition into practical results.

  • Connects industry leaders across sectors
  • AI Discovery Clinic for real business use cases
  • Neutral, vendor-agnostic AI adoption support

Singapore Manufacturing Federation (SMF)

Since 1932, the largest national body representing Singapore’s manufacturing industries.

  • About 5,000 corporate members, 10 industry groups
  • Drives digitalisation and productivity
  • Champions global competitiveness of manufacturing
